summary: No defect found in the inspected cap15 deletion contradictions or Theorem 2 support bridge. The B4 equality guard is essential and is applied with the correct surviving anchors and permitted root pairs. A concrete rho=8 family falsifies broader unguarded classification/support claims, but those claims are absent here. Frozen hashes and alpha identity match; my previously resolved neighbourhood revision remains intact.

findings.statement: The hub scalar bounds without B4 admit 50 bounded states; B4 removes them. Root-pair traces p0i remain locally permitted, so a blanket prohibition of all hub-pair traces would be invalid.
findings.disposition: The source proof explicitly retains p0i and derives strict satellite capacities using B4; no repair is required.

findings.statement: A separated P8 plus H7 family has 15 triples, support 13 and rho=8, and is sunflower-free. It refutes extensions of the R16-minus-one classification to rho<=8 and of the eleven-point support conclusion to all size-15 SF3 families.
findings.disposition: The manuscript keeps exact rho=7 and rho<=6 respectively, so this is a boundary test rather than a counterexample to either asserted result.

checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-outer-deletion-exclusion.md and independently derived the residual counting identities; exhaustively checked its bounded scalar consequences using standard-library integer loops.
checks.observation: All four surviving hub cones are actual. Their summed neighbourhood demand is 3S+4P+4T+4q>=104, while residual hub incidence is <=37 after subtracting 23 root incidences. Exact singleton pools give S<=32 and S<=30 when P>0. No integer state satisfies these consequences. Residual members avoiding the hubs and arbitrary exterior multiplicities were retained.

checks.scope: Hub-deletion B4 guard and strict satellite capacities
checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-hub-deletion-exclusion.md, especially equations (1)-(11); independently enumerated three-covers of the triangle-plus-path graph with two additional fresh labels, then checked the reduced deficit/pair inequalities.
checks.observation: For edges 45,46,56,02,03, the only three-covers are 045,046,056. Thus B4 permits p0i while prohibiting the specified opposite satellite pair and triple traces. Only the three surviving Q_i are used. The weaker satellite system has 50 states, but adding even the necessary consequences of the equality guards leaves zero; the strict-cap system likewise has zero. The proof derives those guards before using strictness and does not silently discard the full-hub trace q.

checks.scope: Theorem 2 degree-two motifs, arbitrary exterior transfer and derived support
checks.method: Read R15-degree2-independent-ordinary-check.md, R15-rho6-degree2-support-reduction.md and the minimum-degree paragraph of LOW15-R15-rho6-partial-status.md; inspected recheck_R15_degree2_support.py and executed only its bounded check_degree6/check_without6 functions without rewriting receipts. Independently checked the incidence inequality.
checks.observation: The replay reconstructed 91 and 78 motifs, with 6 and 18 survivors. Every exterior candidate uses one fresh point; the whole-completion pair-capacity budgets have histogram 0:3,1:7,2:6,3:2. All 74,761 six-subsets fail by literal pair conflicts with a motif triple. It also checked 364 extension witnesses, 1,580 sunflower witnesses and nine rho witnesses. Consequently the finite universe covers the entire completion, not merely each triple separately. With used degrees 3-6, I>=60 and I<=285/2-7n imply n<=11; the complete root-star cases then follow. The later target-15 proof trees were not replayed in this round.

checks.scope: Concrete counterexample testing the rho guards
checks.method: Constructed P10 minus 012 and 015 on points 0-5, plus the displayed H7 translated to points 6-12; directly checked all triples of members for equal pairwise intersections and counted disjointness.
checks.observation: The explicit family is {023,034,045,124,134,135,235,245} together with {6,8,9},{6,8,10},{6,9,10},{7,8,10},{7,9,10},{6,7,11},{6,7,12}. It has 15 distinct triples, support 13, rho=8 and zero three-sunflowers. Hence exact-rho7 classification and rho<=6 support assumptions cannot be dropped. The manuscript and source-map retain both assumptions and separately handle rho=8.
